```{r}
money <- read.csv('~/Downloads/WSS_Table_No._01___Reserve_Bank_of_India_-_Liabilities_and_Assets-3.csv')
```

```{r}
head(money)
```

```{r}
money <- money[money$Item.Desc.WSS=='1 Notes Issued', ]
```

```{r}
head(money)
```

```{r}
money$Week <- as.Date(substr(as.character(money$Week),1,10))
```

```{r}
head(money)
```

```{r}
require(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
qplot(Week,Amount,data=money, geom=c('point', 'line'), ylab='Amount (Rs Billion)') + theme_bw(16)
```

```{r}
money <- money[with(money,order(Week)),]
```

```{r}
money$Diff <- c(0, money$Amount[-1] - money$Amount[-nrow(money)])
```
```{r}
head(money)
```

```{r}
money$Growth <- money$Diff / money$Amount
```

```{r}
head(money)
```

```{r}
(1+mean(money[money$Week > as.Date('2017-06-30'),'Growth']))^52-1
```

```{r}
(1+mean(money[money$Week < as.Date('2016-10-15') & money$Week > as.Date('2016-06-29'),'Growth']))^52-1
```

```{r}
tail(money[money$Week < as.Date('2016-11-08'),])
```
